zh: 频道运营计划支持按专题或指定单个功能亮点（如会话共享、长期记忆、上下文管理）定向生成，新增 Dragon Claw 工作技巧模版。
运营设置支持动态级联选择具体亮点与专题联动切换，技能提示词同步支持点名介绍特定功能。
增强 Windows 便携版自更新原子替换与容灾机制：支持进程退出重试与 EBUSY 共享冲突等待，替换失败自动回退旧版并保留原程序。
便携版更新包统一暂存至用户数据目录下的专用更新目录，并按官方资产标准命名，启动时安全清理历史残余缓存。
en: Channel operations plans now support targeting specific feature highlights (e.g., chat sharing, persistent memory, context compaction) alongside random rotation, adding Dragon Claw productivity templates.
Operations settings dynamic cascade selection enables choosing specific highlights per topic, and ops skills support targeting named features directly.
Enhanced Windows portable app self-updater reliability with atomic executable replacement, automatic EBUSY retries, and safe rollback on failure.
Portable update packages stage cleanly in a dedicated updates directory with standard asset names, safely cleaning up old cache on startup.
